title: Water Station Depleted
description: The main water supply station in Zone A has run out of water, causing distress among waiting pilgrims.
recommended_action: Dispatch emergency water tanker immediately to Zone A.

title: Severe Bottleneck and Long Queue
description: A massive queue of over 400 people has formed near the Zone A intersection, moving very slowly under direct sunlight.
recommended_action: Open secondary barricade lines to relieve pressure and distribute water to the waiting crowd.

title: Pilgrim Fainted due to Heat
description: A middle-aged woman collapsed in the crowd due to severe heat exhaustion.
recommended_action: Immediate medical evacuation required. Clear pathway for stretcher.

title: Multiple Dehydration Cases
description: Three individuals reporting severe dizziness and nausea due to dehydration.
recommended_action: Provide ORS and move individuals to the shaded triage tent.

title: Elderly Man Unconscious
description: An elderly pilgrim is unresponsive; suspected heat stroke.
recommended_action: Dispatch advanced life support ambulance. Crowd control needed.

title: Child Suffering from Heat Exhaustion
description: A 10-year-old child is vomiting and severely dehydrated in the queue.
recommended_action: Extract child from queue and move to Medical Camp immediately.

title: Group Experiencing Heat Cramps
description: A group of five pilgrims stopped moving due to severe muscle cramps from heat.
recommended_action: Send volunteers with electrolyte packets and assist them to a shaded zone.

title: Fainting Incident Near Checkpoint
description: Young adult fainted while waiting for security check. Recovered but weak.
recommended_action: Patient stabilized at local medical desk.

title: Dangerous Crowd Compression at Ghat Stairs
description: Density has exceeded safe limits on the steps leading to the water. People are unable to move.
recommended_action: Halt incoming traffic to the ghat immediately. Deploy PA systems to guide crowd to lateral exits.

title: Smoke Emitting from Kitchen Area
description: Thick black smoke is billowing from a commercial stall kitchen, causing panic nearby.
recommended_action: Evacuate the Food Court immediate sector. Dispatch fire unit.

title: Severe Exit Congestion at Main Gates
description: Departing crowds are blocking the primary exit paths, causing a backflow of pilgrims.
recommended_action: Open emergency lateral gates and redirect outgoing crowd flow.

title: Rumor of Structural Collapse Spreading
description: A false rumor about a bridge collapse is spreading through the crowd, inducing panic running.
recommended_action: Use all PA systems to broadcast factual reassurances immediately to stop panic.

title: Elderly Person Collapsed Near Gate 7
description: An elderly pilgrim collapsed near Gate 7 and a crowd started gathering around the area.
recommended_action: Clear the surrounding crowd, dispatch a medical team, and secure the area for ambulance access.

title: Asthma Attack in Crowd
description: A young man is experiencing severe respiratory distress near the entry checkpoint.
recommended_action: Administer oxygen immediately and prepare for transport.

title: False Stampede Alarm
description: People started running after a loud noise was misinterpreted as a stampede.
recommended_action: Deploy guards to visible vantage points to calm the crowd.

title: Bomb Threat Rumor on Social Media
description: A viral forward claiming a suspicious package is near the transport hub.
recommended_action: Conduct immediate sweep to verify; counter-message on social media.

title: Lost Child Reported
description: A 5-year-old boy wearing a red shirt is separated from his parents.
recommended_action: Broadcast child description to all volunteers and escort parents to Help Desk.

title: Barricade Damage
description: A section of the bamboo barricade has snapped under crowd pressure.
recommended_action: Form a human chain while maintenance team repairs the barricade.

title: Minor Cut Injury
description: A pilgrim suffered a minor cut from a sharp edge on a handrail.
recommended_action: First aid administered.

title: Suspicious Unattended Bag
description: A black backpack left unattended near the VIP lounge entry.
recommended_action: Area cleared, bag inspected and found to contain personal clothes. Returned to owner.

title: Slip and Fall Near Washrooms
description: Wet floor caused a pilgrim to slip, resulting in a suspected ankle sprain.
recommended_action: Patient treated and floor dried.

title: Lost Elderly Person
description: An 80-year-old man suffering from dementia lost his group.
recommended_action: Keep person comfortably in medical camp while broadcasting details.

title: Argument Escaped into Scuffle
description: Two groups of pilgrims got into a physical altercation over space in the queue.
recommended_action: Security intervened and separated the groups. No major injuries.

title: Power Outage at Stalls
description: A localized power trip has plunged a section of the Food Court into darkness.
recommended_action: Dispatch electricians and provide emergency lighting to prevent panic.

title: Minor Burn Incident
description: A cook suffered a minor oil burn at a food stall.
recommended_action: Treated with burn ointment on site.

title: Water Leakage Creating Mud Risk
description: A broken pipe is flooding a walking path, creating slippery conditions.
recommended_action: Shut off local valve and spread sand over the mud.

title: Lost Toddler Found
description: A 3-year-old girl was found crying near the barricades. Parents not yet located.
recommended_action: Take child to central help desk and broadcast details on PA.

title: Camera Feed Disconnected
description: CCTV Camera pointing to Zone B exit has lost signal.
recommended_action: Dispatch IT maintenance crew to reboot the switch.

title: Overcrowding at E-Rickshaw Stand
description: Pilgrims aggressively pushing to board limited e-rickshaws.
recommended_action: Establish proper queue ropes and deploy guards to manage boarding.

title: Heat Exhaustion Case
description: A man feels dizzy and unable to stand.
recommended_action: Given ORS and rested for 30 minutes. Recovered.

title: Minor Stampede Averted
description: A sudden rush to grab free food distributions caused temporary crushing.
recommended_action: Halt distribution temporarily until lines are reorganized.

title: Pilgrim with Hypoglycemia
description: Diabetic pilgrim collapsed due to low blood sugar.
recommended_action: Administered IV glucose. Patient stable.

title: Unauthorized Drone Spotted
description: A small unidentified drone flying over the crowd area.
recommended_action: Drone pilot identified as media. Permit verified.

title: Pickpocketing Reported
description: Three complaints of stolen wallets in the last hour.
recommended_action: Increase plainclothes security patrols in the area.

title: Temporary Washroom Overflow
description: Mobile toilet units have reached capacity and are overflowing.
recommended_action: Dispatch sanitation trucks immediately and redirect crowd to Zone C washrooms.

title: Fire Extinguisher Tampered
description: A fire extinguisher was discharged playfully by miscreants.
recommended_action: Individuals reprimanded. Extinguisher replaced.

title: Dog Bite Incident
description: A stray dog bit a pilgrim on the leg.
recommended_action: Administered rabies vaccine and wound cleaned. Animal control notified.

title: Medical Supply Shortage
description: Running low on IV fluids at the secondary medical tent.
recommended_action: Courier supplies from central hospital storage immediately.

title: Lost Backpack with Valuables
description: A pilgrim reported a lost bag containing IDs and cash.
recommended_action: Bag found by volunteer and returned to owner.

title: Heat Rash and Exhaustion
description: Multiple complaints of severe heat rashes needing attention.
recommended_action: Distributing calamine lotion and advising rest in shade.

title: PA System Malfunction
description: The public address speakers in Zone C are generating loud static noise.
recommended_action: System rebooted and cable replaced.

title: Minor Traffic Collision
description: A supply truck reversed into a barricade pole.
recommended_action: No injuries. Truck repositioned and pole straightened.

title: Pilgrim with Seizures
description: A person is having an epileptic seizure in the crowd.
recommended_action: Area secured, medical team stabilized patient. Transported to hospital.

title: Water Tanker Stuck in Crowd
description: A water tanker unable to reach Zone A due to dense crowd blocking the path.
recommended_action: Deploy guards to create a corridor for the tanker to pass.

title: Trash Bins Overflowing
description: Garbage has spilled onto the walking path, causing tripping hazards.
recommended_action: Call sanitation crew for immediate waste clearing.

title: Lost Child Seeking Parents
description: A young boy named Rahul is at the help desk looking for his parents.
recommended_action: Parents heard the PA announcement and reunited.

title: Suspicious Individual Near Equipment
description: A person was seen tampering with the generator wires.
recommended_action: Individual detained by police. Turned out to be unauthorized contractor.

title: Crowd Pushing at VIP Entrance
description: General crowd attempting to breach the VIP entry lane.
recommended_action: Reinforcements deployed to secure barricades and redirect crowd.

title: Person with Chest Pain
description: A man in his 50s is complaining of severe chest pain and sweating.
recommended_action: ECG done on site, suspected myocardial infarction. Transported safely.

title: Minor Heat Exhaustion
description: Pilgrim felt dizzy but managed to sit down under a tree.
recommended_action: App provided directions to nearest water point. User marked self as safe.
